question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

As thick as two short planks
solution:
The correct answer is **'extremely stupid'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **'as thick as two short planks' **is used to refer to a person who is very stupid or silly.
